dct_description_sm:
The Capital Budget & Forecast Storm Water Management Line items 
represent the storm water management erosion control and drainage.creek 
improvement locations found throughout the city. These projects have 
all been identified in the capital budget and scheduled from the current
 year until 10 years later. The items from Year 2-10 are part of the 
capital forecast and could be subject to change as priority setting and 
budget funding levels change.
